allocation_regime.label: production_baseline_16gib
allocation_regime.rationale: the allocation the pre-registered protocol fixed, closest to the current production process_genomicsdb label
allocation_regime.not_superseded_by: the later common-ceiling comparison run, which uses one larger GenotypeGVCFs ceiling for every experiment; that run measures the E0-E4 one-factor differences and does not replace this result
allocation_regime.explicitly_not_done: this experiment was not retried at a larger allocation until it passed and relabelled a success; the per-contig baseline's failure at 16 GiB stands as the finding about the current production resource contract

throughput_collapse.interpretation: garbage-collection death spiral: the live set genuinely approached the Java heap ceiling rather than the container clipping native allocations only

host_during_run.interpretation: host memory and swap were never constrained; the kill was the per-container cgroup limit alone

gatk_log_evidence: Import of all batches to GenomicsDB completed!
batching_exercised.note: 51 samples against batch-size 50 produced a real two-batch import in every interval that started, so genomicsdb_batch_size was genuinely exercised rather than merely configured

observations.genomicsdb_import_peak_rss_is_flat: 1.27-1.55 GiB across 37-65 Mb intervals at 51 samples, so its 16 GiB allocation is ample and is not the constraint
observations.genotype_peak_rss_scales_with_interval_l: about 0.28 GiB per Mb at 51 samples across the completed tasks, which is why the longest contig is the one that failed
observations.second_longest_contig_also_near_ceiling: interval_0002 recorded 14.66 GiB against the same 16 GiB ceiling, so by this repository's standing methodology it is also not a trustworthy unconstrained reading

conclusion: The per-contig baseline plan does not fit a 16 GiB GenotypeGVCFs allocation at 51 samples. The failure is a resource-contract finding, not a scientific one: no threshold, ploidy, reference or interval semantic was changed to obtain it, and the evidence is retained rather than retried into a pass.
follow_up: GenotypeGVCFs re-measured alone at a generous ceiling to obtain a true unconstrained peak, then every experiment re-run under one identical, larger GenotypeGVCFs tier with the Java heap derived below its container limit.
retained_private_artifacts: run directory, per-task logs, commands, allocations, container states and host monitor remain on the benchmark host outside Git

scaling_observation_scope.relationship: GenotypeGVCFs peak RSS grew with interval length across the completed per-contig tasks at fixed sample count
scaling_observation_scope.validity: an observation at 51 samples under this reference, GATK version, ploidy and HaplotypeCaller condition only
scaling_observation_scope.explicitly_not_claimed: no linear extrapolation to 327 samples is asserted from it; sample-count scaling was not measured here, and the two longest contigs' readings were themselves capped by the 16 GiB ceiling
scaling_observation_scope.superseded_for_projection_by: docs/evidence/issue45/genotype_memory_model_51_samples.json, which fits the same relationship on unclipped readings from the common-ceiling run. The 0.28 GiB/Mb figure here is a ratio over readings two of which were clipped by the 16 GiB ceiling under test, so it is retained as what this failed run showed, not used for sizing or projection.
